inspiration.observed_pattern: A UNION of two differently ordered GROUP BY ... WITH ROLLUP queries feeds an INSERT duplicate-key refresh, with NULL rollup dimensions normalized before insertion.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one report day, one product with two dimension combinations, one seeded product subtotal, and the two rollup orders. The source procedure and all unrelated dimensions are removed while retaining the parser and duplicate-key mismatch.

fixture_notes: Two source rows generate detail and subtotal combinations. The seeded product subtotal must refresh from 2 rather than remain 99; the original mismatch is isolated to the UNION/ROLLUP/upsert statement.
determinism_notes: All rows and grouping keys are fixed, with one ordered final read and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE rollup_events (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, report_day DATE NOT NULL, product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, version_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, channel_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, device_id INT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE rollup_summary (report_day DATE NOT NULL, product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, version_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, channel_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, device_count INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (report_day, product_code, version_label, channel_label))

steps.sql: INSERT INTO rollup_summary (report_day, product_code, version_label, channel_label, device_count) SELECT '2026-03-10', COALESCE(product_code, 'ALL'), COALESCE(version_label, 'ALL'), COALESCE(channel_label, 'ALL'), COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) FROM rollup_events WHERE report_day = '2026-03-10' GROUP BY product_code, version_label, channel_label WITH ROLLUP UNION SELECT '2026-03-10', COALESCE(product_code, 'ALL'), COALESCE(channel_label, 'ALL'), COALESCE(version_label, 'ALL'), COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) FROM rollup_events WHERE report_day = '2026-03-10' GROUP BY product_code, channel_label, version_label WITH ROLLUP ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE device_count = VALUES(device_count)
SELECT report_day, product_code, version_label, channel_label, device_count FROM rollup_summary ORDER BY report_day, product_code, version_label, channel_label
